exposure: diagnosis of Neonatal Abstinence Syndrome (NAS) within 30 days of birth
outcome: rate of NAS by demographic and birth characteristics
long-term costs attributable to NAS status and demographic and birth characteristics
distribution of expenditure over the enrollment period
cohort: The study included 346,259 neonates born to Medicaid-eligible mothers in Alabama between January 1, 2010, and December 31, 2020.
finding: Neonates with an NAS diagnosis had a different demographic profile and incurred an estimated additional $17,921 in costs to state Medicaid agencies over the enrollment period compared to those without NAS.
